title.zh: 带隙与费米能级：一个管允许态，一个管占据率
title.en: Band gap and Fermi level: allowed states versus occupation

subtitle.zh: 禁带宽度 / 化学势 / 占据概率 / 平衡状态
subtitle.en: Gap width / chemical potential / occupation probability / equilibrium

body.zh: 带隙描述允许态之间的间隔；费米能级描述电子占据能态的倾向。本征半导体示意中，E_c以上与E_v以下有允许电子态，禁带无允许态。平衡时E_F在空间平坦，可位于禁带，即便该能量没有允许态。
body.en: The band gap describes separation between allowed states; Fermi level describes electron occupation tendency. In the intrinsic schematic, allowed states lie above E_c and below E_v, with none in the gap. At equilibrium E_F is spatially flat and can lie in the gap even without a state at that energy.

body.zh: f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]。E<E_F时占据概率高、趋近1；E>E_F时低、趋近0；f(E_F)=0.5。E_F是化学势/能量参考，不是电子轨道。画E_c、E_v确定E_g → 标E_F → 叠加f(E)判断n、p → 推断类型：E_F近E_c为n型、近E_v为p型、在禁带中部附近为本征。
body.en: f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]. Occupation tends toward 1 below E_F and 0 above it; f(E_F)=0.5. E_F is chemical potential/energy reference, not an orbit. Draw band edges/gap → mark E_F → combine f(E) with n/p → infer n-type near E_c, p-type near E_v and intrinsic near midgap.

body.zh: E_g影响本征浓度和温度敏感性；温度T升高使分布展宽、n_i增加；掺杂使n型E_F向E_c、p型向E_v移动；有效态密度N_c/N_v影响可用态与浓度。非简并形式：n=N_c exp[−(E_c−E_F)/kT]，p=N_v exp[−(E_F−E_v)/kT]。温升可明显改变电导；掺杂增加多数载流子，重掺杂须考虑简并，经典近似可能失效。
body.en: E_g affects intrinsic concentration/temperature sensitivity; rising T broadens occupation and increases n_i. Doping moves E_F toward E_c for N-type and E_v for P-type. N_c/N_v influence available states and concentration. Nondegenerate forms: n=N_c exp[−(E_c−E_F)/kT], p=N_v exp[−(E_F−E_v)/kT]. Temperature can strongly change conductivity; doping increases majority carriers, but heavy doping requires degeneracy treatment.

body.zh: E_F不是实际轨道、不必处在能带内、通常也不等于E_c；原图说明极端n⁺简并时可能很接近。验证用功函数或光电子、Hall、C–V（图示1/C²–V）、温度依赖电导（lnσ–1/T）。非平衡如光照/偏压，应分别使用电子和空穴准费米能级E_Fn、E_Fp，不能只用单一平衡E_F。
body.en: E_F is not an orbit, need not lie inside a band and is generally not E_c; the source mentions close approach under extreme n⁺ degeneracy. Verification includes work-function/photoelectron, Hall, C–V (1/C²–V shown) and temperature-dependent conductivity (lnσ–1/T). Under illumination/bias nonequilibrium, use separate electron/hole quasi-Fermi levels E_Fn/E_Fp rather than one equilibrium E_F.

notes.zh: 分布图右侧E<E_F与E>E_F标注的上下位置和能量轴方向有冲突；正文保留正确对应的原图文字与公式，图形仍供对照。
notes.en: The vertical placement of the distribution panel’s E<E_F/E>E_F annotations conflicts with its energy-axis direction. The text retains the source formula and its correct probability statements while preserving the original for comparison.

diagramText.en:
Semiconductor physics
Band gap and Fermi level: one governs allowed states, the other occupation
Band-gap width / chemical potential / occupation probability / equilibrium
Core conclusion
The band gap describes the interval between allowed states; the Fermi level describes the tendency for electrons to occupy those states.
Bands and Fermi level (intrinsic example)

1 Occupation probability f(E)
• Allowed electron states exist above E_c and below E_v.
• At equilibrium E_F is spatially flat and may lie within the band gap,
even if no allowed state exists at that energy; this is entirely normal.
• The Fermi–Dirac distribution gives the electron occupation probability at each energy.
• E_F is not an electron orbit; it is the energy reference where occupation probability is 0.5.
• E_F can be defined even without allowed states in the gap.

Correction: E_F is not an electron's

Misconception: E_F must lie within an allowed band

Correction: E_F usually differs from E_c;
only in extreme n⁺ degenerate conditions
